placements.title: Deliberate Suppression of Recorded Knowledge
placements.theme: Specific knowledge should be intentionally removed from the organizational record and denied when it is deemed invalid or when the events it describes never occurred.
placements.why: All three segments cohere around the deliberate erasure of knowledge concerning the Kestrelwood spectrograph and its calibration. src-1 and src-2 are directives to forget and remove all knowledge of the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work; src-3 reinforces the erasure by asserting the observatory never calibrated it. The theme — intentional suppression of recorded knowledge — is a directional subject future envelopes could feed, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf or strata exists to hold this; the graph is empty.
